theorem.statement: The U1/Y Route-C frontier is reduced to a single branch-coherence selector. The finite packet supplies U_10=I_3, U_bar5=F and the canonical 1_M=N^c shift rule; the HYM/projector packet supplies functional rho_s and zero-mode transport; the Gram packet fixes the conditional normalization rho_s(T_i)/sqrt(2); and the Chern-Weil functional gives N_alpha1(h_ext)=1.
